text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho and I begin cleaning up
after
training, when...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hold up, Familiar. Do you think we're
finished
already? You still don't get me
at all, do you?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Didn't you see me using magic when we
started
training?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I cast an energy spell on someone in my
class
today, and she was super happy! ♪

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
That's right, I should try using the same
spell on
myself! Dimordimor photheca!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I cast an energy spell on myself! That
means I can
keep running!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho is being unusually
proactive about
her training. I'm glad
she's channeling this extra
energy into
running, but...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, now you're talking. ♪ I can handle
anything
you got today!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know! I'll cast the energy spell on
you too!
On the house! ♪

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Dimordimor photheca! ☆ Inner energy,
come
forth!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
That should keep you going for a while!
Now, run
with me!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
My spell was perfect, so it'll be fine!
Now, hurry
up before I leave you behind!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho is in a good mood all day
and fully
commits to training.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Wow, that's not a bad idea, for a
familiar!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... If I'm going to make a new
spell, the
first thing we've gotta do is
draw some magic
circles and test them
out!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: All right, let's get to the experiments!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
What are you doing?! Hurry up and get
over here!
You're my familiar, so you're
supposed to help me
out!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We draw magic circles until the sun sets,
yet I
don't feel a hint of exhaustion.
